title: GET /routes/{id}/versions – 200 response
description: Every version of the route by version number, and their checkpoints by version and position. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Error responses use api/error.json.

next_cursor.description: Absent or null: the list is complete. A string: the server pages this list (at most 500 route versions per page, each with all of its checkpoints); request the next page with ?cursor=<next_cursor> and the same filters, and merge the pages. The server may start paging without a new schema version, so a client must follow it.
